thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: [Sev2] runtime-serving-prod - multiple containers crashlooping with SIGSEGV and occasional CUDA OOM. 5xx rate rose from 1.8% -> 19% across text-gen routes. First alerts from prom and k8s crashloopbackoff. Oncall: @carla. Alert page: https://infra.redwood/alerts/1932104321

carla: acked. I'm triaging now, pinging eng-runtime and infra. Starting with pod list and node health.

frank: saw GPU ECC errors and several NVRM Xid (13) entries earlier on node gnode-42. Could be memory corruption or bad kernel launch.

carla: grabbing logs from one of the crashlooping pods runtime-serve-prod-2-5f7c:
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs runtime-serve-prod-2-5f7c -c runtime | sed -n '1,200p'
...
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] runtime_main: INFO loading model "gpt-medium"
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z] fused_kernel_cm: launch fused_attention (batch=64, seq=1024)
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z] runtime_engine[2110]: RuntimeError: CUDA illegal memory access
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z] runtime_engine[2110]: FATAL: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at fused_attention_cuda.cu:487
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z] runtime_engine[2110]: stack:
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z]   0x7f9c2a8 libfusedkernels.so(+0x1f40b) [0x7f9c2a8]
[2026-03-15T14:12:13Z]   0x7f9c2b0 runtime_main(+0x6a1f) [0x7f9c2b0]
...
```

gina: dmesg from gnode-42 shows GPU-reset messages and Xid 31/32 occasionally. snippet:
```
[ 3456.789012] NVRM: Xid (31) -- PID 2110: Ch 0000003f, but with illegal address during kernel execution.
[ 3456.789013] NVRM: GPU 0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```

carla: initial hypothesis: a fused attention kernel regression in the v2.5.0 build that triggers on high batch/long-context loads, sometimes escalates to OOM and GPU resets. containment plan: (1) pin runtime image to last-known-good (v2.4.2) on prod, (2) cordon gnode-42 and drain to avoid instantiating new pods there, (3) add runtime feature-flag to disable fused kernels (RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1) as a short-term mitigation for canary.

dinesh: starting a conservative rollout: set image redwood/runtime:v2.4.2 and set env var RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=true for runtime-serving deployment. I'll do a 5% canary first.

incident-bot: ACTION: started rollout of runtime-serving -> redwood/runtime:v2.4.2 with RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=true by dinesh at 1932104365.

frank: reducing replicas on runtime-serving from 12->6 to lower concurrent GPU memory pressure during mitigation window. Also adjusting HPA min to 2.

gina: routing team — any objections to steering high-risk tenants to dedicated-hosted fallback clusters while we stabilize? This would reduce blast radius.

carla: agreed. I'm creating temporary route for tenants flagged as "at-risk" by tracing. will update routing table for tenant:research-labs to fallback cluster.

frank: after cordon+drain gnode-42, I see fewer new crashloops. existing pods on that node terminated during drain.

incident-bot: ROLLOUT: runtime-serving canary (5%) healthy after 3m. increasing to 100% at 1932104450.

dinesh: rollout to 100% complete. monitoring for new crashloops.

gina: visible 5xx dropping from 19% -> 4.5% after rollout and routing changes. Some tenants still report intermittent failures; looks correlated with long-sequence requests (>2k tokens).

carla: collecting core dumps and gpu hw traces from gnode-42 before uncordoning. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/1932104321/ for postmortem. Please include nvidia-smi -q, kernel logs, and all stdout/stderr from crashed containers.

frank: repro attempt in local infra with stress harness (batch=64, seq=1536) reproduced segfault on v2.5.0 but not on v2.4.2. capturing command and input. opening ticket INF-4832 with repro steps.

incident-bot: INCIDENT_STATUS updated to "mitigated" by dinesh at 1932104680. Oncall transferred to gina.

gina: summary for CS & customers: brief outage with elevated 5xx for ~90 minutes impacting research-labs, genai-beta, and analytics-pro. Mitigations: cordon/drain of one node, rollback/pin to v2.4.2, disable fused kernels via env flag, temporary routing to dedicated cluster for affected tenants.

carla: follow-ups and action items logged:
- INF-4832: reproduce and root cause (assigned to frank)
- RUNTIME-4950: add CI stress test covering batch-size/seq-len matrix that triggered bug (assigned to eng-ml)
- OPS-3001: add node health alerts for repeated Xid/GPU resets (assigned to eng-infra)
- SAFETY-flag: block auto-enable of fused kernels until patch+soak (assigned to product)

frank: I'll work on a minimal failing test and try to bisect the fused kernel changes to find the offending commit. ETA 48h.

gina: creating a short postmortem skeleton in #postmortems and pinging CS for customer comms. Thanks all for quick response. :clap:

carla: leaving notes here: don't uncordon gnode-42 until we confirm no GPU hardware faults in addition to software regression. need firmware/driver sanity check.

incident-bot: Thread will remain open until RCA is attached to INF-4832.

(edited)
